title: Paul's First Missionary Journey: Antioch in Pisidia
description: Paulus and Barnabas come to Antioch in Pisidia and speak in the synagogue on the Sabbath. Paul delivers a long speech where he summarizes Israel's history from the election and the exodus from Egypt, through the judges, Saul and David, up to Jesus as the promised Savior, and proclaims forgiveness and justification by faith. The next Sabbath almost the whole city gathers, but the Jews are filled with jealousy and contradict them. Paulus and Barnabas then turn boldly to the Gentiles, who receive the word with joy. The Jews incite leading men and noble women, and persecution drives the apostles out to Iconium, while the disciples are filled with joy and the Holy Spirit.
